name: Recall.ai Meeting Bots
description: Sends bots to Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams meetings via Recall.ai. Captures real-time transcripts, audio, and video recordings. Exposes a loopback API at port 18791 (nginx proxies /recall/ to it).

requiredEnv.description: Recall.ai API key (from app.recall.ai → Settings → API Keys)
Tenant public hostname, used for the webhook callback URL
